subject: Architecture review — Redwood <> CloudWorks: agenda & pre-read
messages:

Date: 2026-03-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Architecture review: Redwood <> CloudWorks — proposed times & pre-read

Hi Marissa / team,

Thanks again for agreeing to an architecture/technical deep-dive between our engineering teams. We were hoping to cover the integration touchpoints (auth, data flows), network/security boundaries, and performance expectations for the initial pilot.

Proposed slots from our side:
- Wed 18 Mar, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 19 Mar, 09:00–10:00 PT

Can you confirm which works best? Also, if you could share an agenda and any pre-read (slides, diagrams, perf numbers) that would help our infra and security folks prepare.

High-level asks from CloudWorks:
- System diagram showing ingress/egress and service-to-service boundaries
- Any firewall/port requirements and TLS/KMS notes
- Expected token throughput and tail latency at pilot scale

Thanks — happy to be flexible on timing.

Best,
Alex Chen
Staff Engineer, CloudWorks
alex.chen@cloudworks.com

Attachments: none (will review pre-read you share)

Alex — thanks for the clear asks. Wed 18 Mar 10:00–11:00 PT works for our core team. If that becomes an issue we'll move to Thu 19, but tentatively holding the 18th.

Attached are a first-pass set of materials for the session:
- architecture_deep_dive_slides_v1.pdf (PDF, 12 slides) — high-level system overview + proposed integration points
- system_diagram_v2.vsdx — editable Visio diagram of traffic flows
- redwood_inference_network_topology.png — simplified topology for sharing with network/security folks

Proposed agenda (45–60 min):
1) 10:00 — 10:05: Introductions & goals (Marissa)
2) 10:05 — 10:20: Redwood architecture overview (serving runtime, routing, caching) (Marcus)
3) 10:20 — 10:35: Integration points & security (auth, network, keys) (Dev)
4) 10:35 — 10:45: Performance expectations & telemetry (Marcus)
5) 10:45 — 10:55: Q&A / next steps / mutual action plan (Lauren)

Pre-read links:
- Slides & source: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-arch-slides
- Confluence doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Architecture+Deep+Dive

Could you confirm who from CloudWorks will join (roles) so we can tailor the run-of-show (e.g., include more on KV cache behavior if infra will attend)? Also let us know if you need a separate session for security/compliance deep-dive.

I'll lock the calendar once we confirm. Zoom link and calendar invite will follow from my calendar.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments:
- architecture_deep_dive_slides_v1.pdf
- system_diagram_v2.vsdx

Thanks Marissa — slides look good. A couple of asks to add to the agenda:
- Can we include a brief section on caching (prefix/KV cache behavior) and how it impacts token throughput? 5 min is fine.
- I'll bring our baseline perf numbers (p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec) and a short note on quantization/precision options we recommend for pilot workloads.

If CloudWorks can confirm whether they'll have infra (network) + security on the call that will determine how deep we go on firewall/KMS details.
